label: geWorld_Collision
note: Selects point/ray or swept-hull collision from extent arguments and returns the nearest hit.

label: swept_hull_world_models
note: Filters and broadphase-tests world models then transforms and traverses BSP hull collision while retaining the nearest hit.

label: point_trace_world_models
note: Point/ray counterpart that scans model BSPs and retains the nearest accepted hit.

label: swept_hull_bsp_traversal
note: Recursively follows BSP side bits and tests contents-matching convex leaves.

label: point_trace_bsp_traversal
note: Recursively follows BSP split planes and checks leaf contents for a point/ray trace.

label: convex_leaf_hull_intersection
note: Tests the swept hull against collision planes for one BSP leaf.

label: swept_hull_broadphase_bounds
note: Builds broadphase bounds spanning query start/end and swept hull extents.

label: bsp_plane_aabb_side_classification
note: Classifies a swept AABB relative to a BSP split plane for recursive traversal.

label: bitmap_vfile_decode
note: Decodes native GeBm images and dispatches Windows BMP data to the BMP reader.

label: bitmap_create_from_filename
note: Opens a bitmap path through a VFile and invokes the bitmap decoder.

label: bitmap_decode_bmp_bi_rgb
note: Parses uncompressed 8/16/24/32-bit BMP data with row padding and orientation handling.

label: bitmap_set_alpha
note: Attaches and reference-counts an alpha bitmap on a base bitmap.

label: world_create_and_initialize
note: Creates world state from a GBSP-backed world-data object or an empty world.

label: world_data_load_gbsp
note: Allocates world data and dispatches the GBSP VFile chunk loader.

label: gbsp_chunk_stream_loop
note: Reads GBSP chunks through the end marker and invokes a follow-up BSP pass.

label: world_add_bitmap
note: Adds a referenced bitmap to the world's attached-bitmap list and marks world bitmap state dirty.

label: world_remove_bitmap
note: Removes a bitmap from the world's attached list and marks world bitmap state dirty.

label: world_bitmap_by_name_wrapper
note: Delegates a world bitmap-name lookup; no direct DLL caller or EXE import was found.

label: case_insensitive_world_bitmap_lookup
note: Searches attached bitmap names with stricmp and returns the matching bitmap pointer.

label: attached_bitmap_list_insert
note: Creates a bitmap reference and appends it to the attached world bitmap list.

label: gbsp_chunk_decode
note: Validates GBSP v15 and chunk element sizes while allocating and reading chunk payloads.

label: bsp_leaf_face_flag_pass
note: Recursively scans BSP leaf face references and propagates a surface flag bit whose meaning remains unknown.

label: world_embedded_bitmap_registration
note: Initializes the world bitmap list and adds bitmaps embedded in the loaded BSP world.

label: puppet_fetch_material_textures
note: Registers non-null actor body material bitmaps with the current world.

label: puppet_set_material_texture
note: Replaces a puppet material bitmap and updates its registration in the world list.

label: geMotion_CreateFromFile
note: Parses retail MOTN 0.F0 records and dispatches each serialized path to gePath_CreateFromFile.

label: gePath_CreateFromFile
note: Parses retail PATH 0.F1/0.F2 text formats and dispatches the binary 0x1001 variant to its reader.

label: gePath_GetTimeExtents
note: Combines the first and last stored rotation/translation key times.

label: quaternion_keys_read_from_file
note: Decodes QKFrame key counts, representation/compression flags, explicit or generated times, and quaternion/axis-angle values.

label: translation_keys_read_from_file
note: Decodes VKFrame key counts, compression flags, explicit or generated times, and XYZ values.

label: gePath_Sample
note: Samples both channels, converts quaternion to a matrix, and writes the translation into the returned transform.

label: path_channel_sample_and_dispatch
note: Normalizes/wraps sample time, brackets adjacent keys, computes the segment fraction, and dispatches by channel sampler slot.

label: rotation_key_mode_to_sampler
note: Maps serialized quaternion key modes 0/1/2 to sampler slots 3/4/5.

label: translation_key_mode_to_sampler
note: Maps serialized translation key modes 0/1/2 directly to sampler slots 0/1/2.

label: translation_key_precompute
note: Builds the stored translation tangent values used by the cubic path sampler.

label: quaternion_key_sign_precompute
note: Compares adjacent quaternion representations and flips a key sign to keep the sampled orientation continuous.

label: geQuaternion_Slerp
note: Performs retail quaternion spherical interpolation with near-parallel and antipodal fallback branches.

label: rotation_mode1_slerp
note: Directly slerps adjacent endpoint quaternions for serialized rotation key mode 1.

label: rotation_mode2_three_slerp
note: Uses three slerps to blend endpoint quaternions and precomputed controls for rotation key mode 2.

label: quaternion_mode2_control_builder
note: Builds mode-2 quaternion control data from a key quaternion and neighboring controls.

label: quaternion_mode2_precompute
note: Applies quaternion hemisphere continuity and fills mode-2 key control quaternions.

label: quaternion_mode1_precompute
note: Applies adjacent-key quaternion hemisphere continuity for mode 1.

label: translation_mode1_cubic_sampler
note: Evaluates the retail cubic translation basis with tangent fields stored in the key records.

label: path_loop_time_normalizer
note: Normalizes channel sample time for looped key ranges before key bracketing.

label: geCamera_Project
note: Projects a camera-space point using negative camera-space Z as depth, with a near-plane clamp.

label: geCamera_TransformAndProject
note: Transforms a point through the camera-space matrix and projects it with negative camera-space Z as depth.

label: geCamera_SetWorldSpaceXForm
note: Stores the camera world transform, transposes its basis for camera-space conversion, and copies the camera position.

label: geActor_SetPose
note: Export wrapper delegates actor pose updates to the internal pose evaluator.

label: ApplyActorMotionAndPose
note: Composes the motion-root transform under the supplied actor transform, samples named bone channels, and applies actor scale to translation.

label: geMotion_GetTransform
note: Samples and composes nested motion transforms into the motion-root transform used by geActor_SetPose.

label: geXForm3d_Multiply
note: Composes two 3x4 basis-plus-translation transforms using the shipped engine matrix order.

label: geXForm3d_Transform
note: Transforms a point by the 3x3 basis and translation in a shipped Genesis transform.

label: UpdateActorBoneTransforms
note: Selects each bone parent and applies the actor root transform after dirty-bone updates.

label: UpdateAnimatedBoneTransform
note: Uses the attachment-validity flag to select parent×sampled versus parent×attachment×sampled quaternion and translation composition.

label: geActor_GetBoneTransformByIndex
note: Returns the computed indexed bone transform for actor pose inspection.

label: geActor_GetBoneAttachment
note: Exposes the stored ACT bone attachment transform used by the flag-0 animated update branch.

label: ClassifyBoneAttachmentQuaternion
note: Sets the runtime branch flag when attachment quaternion X/Y/Z are strictly within the -0.0001 to +0.0001 double bounds.

label: InitializeRuntimeBoneAttachment
note: Converts and stores ACT attachment quaternion/matrix, clears sampled channels, and classifies the attachment branch.
